runtime.startup: Opening Kite starts its independent session daemon automatically.

requirements.gui_detach_reconnect: verified with preserved shell PID and reconstructed contents
requirements.bounded_recent_replay: 2 MiB canonical Ghostty scrollback per pane; safe VT snapshots capped at 16 MiB
requirements.cwd_title_metadata: verified against real chdir and OSC title output
requirements.horizontal_vertical_splits: nested splits, divider persistence, focus and pane movement exercised
requirements.keyboard_navigation: character events, indexed session selection, pane focus and configurable shortcuts exercised
requirements.basic_settings: font family/size, shell, theme and shortcuts persisted and applied

evidence.state_contracts: Tests/TerminalState.c: primary/alternate state, safe replay, wide wraps, protected cells, REP, partial UTF-8 and CSI execution
evidence.framing_contracts: Tests/ModelWire.swift: fragmentation, payload bounds, large control frames, split collapse

limits: Process persistence covers GUI restarts, not daemon death, logout or machine reboot. Lost processes are shown as exited with unknown/non-success status; restart is explicit.
Recent history is bounded. Kitty graphics/APC images are not reconstructed by the pinned Ghostty formatter.
Some uncommon VT bookkeeping states cannot be represented by the current safe snapshot codec and report a restoration error rather than silently corrupting output.
Transport latency measurements exclude native keyboard dispatch and GPU rendering.
